title: AI-Native Software Engineer (all genders)
company: AITHYRA Research Institute for Biomedical Artificial Intelligence
description:
Your role

Employment Type Full Time

Application Deadline 18.05.2026

Apply now

Application details

We are seeking a seeking an outstanding AI-Native Software Engineer who will be joining a world-class team and help build and automate the internal software and operations platform that keeps AITHYRA running — with a clear focus on AI-enabling our administrative and business workflows. When capacity allows, you will also contribute to scientific tooling that supports our researchers. At AITHYRA, we have embraced AI-assisted development as our standard way of building software — using tools like OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, and other agentic coding environments. We are looking for an experienced software developer who is ready to take the next step: becoming an AI-augmented engineer who designs, orchestrates, and ships applications at a pace only possible when humans and AI agents work together.

As our AI-Native Software Engineer, your primary mission is to automate and AI-enable AITHYRA's internal operations - finance, HR, procurement, document handling, reporting, IT onboarding, and the countless administrative workflows that a fast-growing research institute depends on. You will design, build, and orchestrate AI-agent-driven pipelines that eliminate repetitive manual work and let our teams focus on science.

Reporting to Stephan Stadlbauer, Head of Scientific Computing, you will translate operational needs into containerized, self-contained services built with heavy AI-agent assistance. Supporting scientific projects and researcher-facing tools is a secondary focus, addressed when administrative automation priorities allow. You don't need to be an AI/ML researcher — but you must be fluent in modern software engineering and genuinely excited about leveraging AI coding agents to multiply your output.

Start date: flexible

Contract: full-time, 40/h week

Positions available: 1

Your Tasks

  • Develop internal applications using AI-assisted development workflows (OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, and similar agentic tools) — embracing the emerging discipline of AI-augmented engineering.
  • Automate business processes end-to-end, designing AI agent pipelines that enable autonomous operations wherever possible - from document workflows to data processing to administrative tasks.
  • Build and maintain containerized services: design multi-container Docker (Compose) stacks that are self-contained, talk via well-defined APIs (REST, MCP, GraphQL), and authenticate via OAuth.
  • Create scientific interfaces and visualizations: develop user-friendly web interfaces to access internal databases, explore datasets, and display visualizations for researchers.
  • Support other teams with their software infrastructure needs - for example, helping AI robotics teams deploy, manage, and maintain their application stacks.
  • Implement and evolve the deployment infrastructure: maintain current Docker Compose-based deployments, and help evaluate and introduce container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes) for services that require high availability in the future.
  • Write clean, well-documented, testable code - primarily in Python - while leveraging AI tools to accelerate development without sacrificing quality or maintainability.
  • Stay at the frontier: continuously evaluate new AI coding tools, agent frameworks, and automation patterns, and bring best practices back to the team.

Your Profile

  • Education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Solid professional experience as a software developer.
  • Hands-on experience with or genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex).
  • Strong working knowledge of containerization - you build, ship, and debug Docker and Docker Compose stacks confidently.
  • Experience designing and consuming APIs (REST, GraphQL) and implementing authentication flows (OAuth/OIDC/SAML).
  • Familiarity with relational and/or document databases and the ability to build interfaces and visualizations on top of them.
  • A genuine passion for automation - you instinctively look for ways to eliminate repetitive work through scripting, agents, or workflow tools.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude towards tackling diverse technical challenges in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong desire to evolve into an AI-augmented engineer - someone who orchestrates AI agents, designs agentic workflows, and continuously pushes the boundary of what a single developer can deliver.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with technical and research teams.

Desired Skills

  • Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker Swarm) for high-availability deployments.
  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-to-service communication standards.
  • Experience building data visualizations or dashboards (e.g., Streamlit, Dash, Grafana, or custom web UIs).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Exposure to front-end frameworks (React, Vue, or similar) for building internal web applications.
  • Experience working with research scientists or in an academic/research environment.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts - not to train models, but to understand what your scientist colleagues are doing and what they need.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary (minimum gross annual salary of EUR 58000)
  • Support for your wellbeing, including access to a company doctor
  • Fresh fruits, sweet treats, and free coffee & tea are available every day
  • Flexible working arrangements, with the option for one home office day per week
  • Core hours: Monday–Thursday 09:00-15:00, Friday 09:00-13:00
  • Meal allowance to make your day a little easier
  • A welcoming community with diverse social and cultural activities
  • Relocation support to help you settle in comfortably if you’re moving to join us

Ready to multiply your impact through the power of AI agents?

Application Process

Please submit your application until: 18.05.2026

We will be in touch afterward.

  • CV highlighting your relevant experience and achievements
  • Cover letter outlining your interest in the position and how your background aligns with the job requirements
  • Contact details of at least two professional references
  • Completed application questionnaire

Apply Online: https://aithyra.onlyfy.jobs/job/ddrup3z043t0e9asm2n6p5lnotmeqke

We are a curiosity-driven, globally minded organization committed to building an inclusive and flexible workplace. At AITHYRA, we believe diverse perspectives strengthen collaboration and spark innovation. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and experiences to help us create teams that reflect the communities our science serves. Your unique contribution matters here - come realize your full potential with us.

Should you have any questions, please contact the AITHYRA HR Team at

recruitment@aithyra.ac.at

description:

Embark on a transformative career journey with Sparta Global, where diversity, innovation, and passion for technology converge. Join us in shaping the future of technology - where your growth is our mission, and your success, our pride. Apply now to be part of our award-winning team at Sparta Global.

About This Role

  • Automation Testing is at the core of defining, developing and testing products for businesses and their customers. Development is a playground where you can create what's needed when you need it.
  • You will play a vital role working within a cross functional team, participating in the development of software with a primary focus being on the testability and performance of software applications.
  • You'll be able to set up full frameworks to perform thousands of tests in a heartbeat on multiple application platforms such as mobile, desktop and web. This feeds into every level of test whether it's unit level, functional, performance and regression.
  • Automation is a major component of agile teams who work diligently to deliver value in short time frames, the execution of scripts and their application in the DevOps pipeline can mean delivery of functional code in unprecedented timeframes.

We're not expecting you to have the proficiencies right away - that's where our award-winning Academy comes in. We are the experts in building skills and confidence in a fun and supportive environment that will not only challenge you but also develop your specialist capabilities ready to work on our clients' projects.

What we're looking for

To be successful for this role you will demonstrate a level of ability in C#, Java or similar. You will be passionate about technology and eager to learn full stack programme development to an advanced level.

We're Seeking Candidates Who Can Exemplify Our Values

  • Empathy and Diversity: Integrity, respect, and a commitment to inclusivity.
  • Drive: A goal-oriented mindset with pride in exceeding targets.
  • Collaboration: A team-focused approach, fostering positive relationships.
  • Innovation: Curiosity, creativity, and openness to diverse ideas.
  • Adaptability: Composure in the face of change.

Our environment is designed to nurture your talents and skills; your hard work and progress are not just appreciated - they're tangibly rewarded. Being employed by Sparta Global is an investment in your future that pays dividends along the way. We give you breadth of experience and skills, along with increasing opportunities to develop further and earn more. No two career paths look the same at Sparta.

Begin your journey by applying online and our team will review your application. If you pass our initial screening, you'll be invited to complete our online assessments and first stage interview. If successful, the final stage is a competency-based interview, here you'll have the opportunity to impress us with your ability to communicate effectively and exhibit behavioural competencies through relevant examples. We're looking for candidates who can demonstrate a collaborative spirit and a growth mindset.

The Talent Team will be there to support and answer any questions you have. You can also visit our YouTube channel to gain valuable insights and expert advice on virtual interviews, strategies to manage nerves, and tips on nonverbal communication.

Company Description

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.

Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

Job Description

For a 12-Month assignment we are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer in Nabern, Germany.

ESD-LU Characterization and Failure Analysis / Quality Assurance Engineer

Renesas is looking for an entry level engineer to perform ESD-LU testing and failure analysis on semiconductor devices. While this is our ideal list, we will consider candidates that do not necessarily have all of the qualifications but have sufficient experience and talent.

Responsibilities/Duties

  • Perform ESD and Latch-up qualification and characterization for new and revised products.
  • Develop ESD-HBM and LU test programs in accordance with JEDEC/AEC standards.
  • Operate ATE testing of semiconductor devices, ex. Teradyne-UFLEX, Advantest-93K.
  • Update test status to internal teams on a regular basis.
  • Debug weaker pins using FA techniques and TLP testing.
  • Work with Design and Application Teams to identify the failure cause.
  • Provide clear and concise documentation of results and publish reports.

Qualifications

  • A self-motivated individual with strong interpersonal problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with JEDEC and AEC standards for ESD and LU testing.
  • Hands on with Oscilloscopes and electronic testing equipments.
  • Basic understanding for failure analysis of semiconductor devices.
  • Technical degree (Bachelor, Master) in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or equivalent.
  • Ideally, knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing and packaging of integrated circuits.
  • Good skills regarding MS Office.
  • Fluent in English and German.

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘To Make Our Lives Easier.’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system-level know-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog & Connectivity, and Power.

With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘To Make Our Lives Easier.’

At Renesas, You Can

  • Launch and advance your career in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things.
  • Make a real impact by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people’s lives easier, safe and secure.
  • Maximize your performance and wellbeing in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day.

Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?

Join Renesas. Let’s Shape the Future together.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (QA)
description:
Are you ready to make your mark in fintech?

At YAPEAL, we haven’t just entered the market; we’ve redefined Embedded Finance. Recently recognized by BILANZ as the country's most innovative SME in finance, we were the first company to secure a FINMA fintech license. The foundation is built. Our proprietary platform is ready to scale through two distinct business lines: YAPEAL Direct, our digital-first B2C & B2B offering, and YAPEAL Embedded, our high-growth B2B2X model.

We're on the lookout for a Quality Assurance Engineer to help us drive innovation and sustainable growth. Every test cycle and release deployment you coordinate and sign-off will directly shape YAPEAL’s future and our path to success.

Curious to learn more? Explore the role and join us in redefining the future of finance!

About The Role:

As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you are the final gatekeeper for our Swiss Fintech platform. You balance hands-on execution with strategic quality control, ensuring every release, from backend services to mobile apps, is rock-solid. You’ll focus heavily on API and integration testing while pragmatically advancing our automation suite to keep pace with our high-growth B2B2X model.

Expect a Day Full of:

  • Gatekeeping & Release Coordination: Take ownership of the release cycle, ensuring all features are validated and meet our high deployment standards.
  • API & Backend Testing: Deep-dive into our microservices and API architecture to ensure robust integration with external partners.
  • End-to-End Validation: Perform manual and automated testing across our full stack, including mobile and web applications.
  • Collaborative QA: Work closely with our developers and product owners to define test scopes and challenge requirements to prevent defects.
  • Smart Automation: Enhance and scale our automated testing suites within the CI/CD ecosystem, ensuring high-impact regression tests provide fast, reliable feedback.
  • Innovation: Drive the integration of AI-driven testing tools to optimize our workflows and stay ahead of the curve.

Who We’re Looking For:

  • API Expert: Proven track record in testing complex backend services and APIs.
  • Technical Versatility: Experience with frontend testing (Mobile & Web) and a solid understanding of test automation frameworks.
  • Python Skills: Proficiency in Python (or a strong willingness to transition to it) for script-based testing.
  • Quality Mindset: Familiarity with design patterns (e.g., Page Object) and Agile environments.
  • Hands-on Spirit: A proactive team player who thrives under tight deadlines and enjoys the fast-paced nature of a scaling Fintech.
  • Communication: Fluency in English, (Swiss-) German is a plus, with the ability to explain complex technical scenarios clearly.

Why Join YAPEAL?

At YAPEAL, we’re on a mission to transform the future of finance, and we’re looking for visionaries like you to join our journey. Here’s why YAPEAL is maybe your place to be:

A Culture of Innovation and Flexibility

Be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values creativity, flexibility, and customer success. At YAPEAL, every idea matters, and every voice counts. We give our people all the flexibility they need to thrive and succeed.

Unmatched Growth Opportunities

As an expanding company, your contribution will directly shape our success and market presence. This is your chance to grow with us and make a tangible impact on the future of finance.

If this sounds like the challenge you’ve been waiting for, we’d love to hear from you.

About Us

Based in Zurich, Switzerland, YAPEAL is revolutionizing the financial landscape with our embedded finance solutions. We empower businesses to seamlessly integrate financial services into their products, enhancing customer experiences and unlocking new revenue streams. Combining cutting-edge technology with Swiss reliability, we’re setting a new standard for digital finance. Join us in building a future that’s uniquely dependable, and consistently innovative.

title: Senior Manual QA Engineer
description:
About Faro Health

Faro Health aims to improve lives by helping life sciences companies answer complex clinical questions simply, efficiently, and effectively. Our software platform serves as a single source of truth for orchestrating complex clinical development. By bringing data and teams together, we empower researchers to design more intelligent trials and reach milestones faster.

The Role

As a Senior Manual QA Engineer, you will be a high-impact individual contributor responsible for ensuring the reliability and integrity of different systems that conform to the Faro Health ecosystem. You are not just a tester; you are a quality advocate who understands that clinical data requires a meticulous, detail-oriented approach.

Leveraging your deep expertise in SaaS, cloud-native architectures, and LLM-augmented workflows, you will analyze complex user requirements, design comprehensive test strategies, prepare/execute test cases and serve as a mentor to junior and contractor engineers. You will play a critical role in our continuous integration environment while ensuring our manual testing foundation remains rock-solid.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Test Strategy & Design: Analyze user requirements and design documents to develop detailed, risk-based test plans and manual test cases for a complex SaaS platform
  • Execution & Reporting: Lead the execution of functional, regression, and integration test cases. Document defects with high precision and provide detailed testing summaries for different team members within the organization
  • Data Validation: Utilize SQL queries to analyze, manipulate, and validate test data
  • Impact Analysis: Evaluate proposed software changes to determine their impact on platform performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and "best practice" mentoring to QA Engineers to improve team efficiency and testing depth
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate the flow of information and maintain close communication with Developers, Product Owners, and DevOps
  • Process Improvement: Apply innovative thinking to improve existing QA methodologies and ensure approved development standards are followed
  • Issue Monitoring: Provide close monitoring and triage of issues found during the SDLC as well as high-priority bugs reported by end-users

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Experience: 8-10+ years in the Quality Assurance discipline, with a proven track record in fast-moving, growth-minded startups. You have successfully navigated the transition from early-stage builds to scaled production environments
  • AI & Efficiency: Proactive expertise in leveraging Generative AI and LLM tools to augment manual testing. This includes using AI for:
  • Synthesizing complex product requirements into comprehensive test cases
  • Optimizing test coverage by using AI to identify edge cases that traditional methods might miss
  • Technical Proficiency: Extensive experience testing cloud-native applications (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and modern, multi-tenant SaaS platforms. You understand the nuances of testing distributed systems
  • Data Skills: Expert-level proficiency in SQL for deep data validation and backend integrity testing
  • Methodology: Strong understanding of black-box and white-box testing, as well as non-functional, performance, accessibility and security testing principles
  • Analytical Mindset: Meticulous and detail-oriented approach with the ability to solve complex problems independently. You don't just find bugs; you perform root cause analysis and provide the technical context necessary for rapid resolution
  • Strategic Communication: Excellent writing, verbal and presentation skills; ability to translate technical bugs into business-level impact for stakeholders and maintain proactive alignment with supervisors and cross-functional teams. Active participation in design reviews, sprint planning, and daily stand-ups
  • Adaptability & Collaboration: Thrives in environments with evolving requirements. You are a self-starter who works effectively across different time zones, fostering a culture of quality across engineering and product teams

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong experience using Quality and Test Management tools (e.g., Jira, QASE)
  • Self-motivated and capable of working under minimal supervision
  • Proactive communicator who excels at risk mitigation by identifying and escalating blockers immediately while independently driving their own testing workstreams and managing high-volume requests with competing priorities
  • Proven ability to build cooperation and cohesiveness across engineering and product teams
  • Familiarity with the "shift-left" approach and supporting the transition from manual-heavy to automation-integrated workflows

Benefits

Salary

Salary range for this position is $119,000 to $141,000 per year.

Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Equity

In addition to this position's salary (listed above), equity will be a major component of the total compensation for this position. We aim to offer higher-than-average equity compensation for a company of our size, and communicate equity amounts at the time of offer issuance.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k)
  • Life Insurance (Basic)
  • Short Term and Long Term Disability
  • Paid Time Off (Flexible Vacation Policy; Paid Sick & Public Holidays Observed)
  • Training & Development Reimbursement
  • Remote or Hybrid Work Environment
  • Peer-to-peer bonus program
  • Company/department outings and events
  • Stock Option Plan
  • Office On-Premises Amenities; gym, restaurant tenant discount, Padel Ninet

This individual will lead Design Controls, Risk Management, and Quality Management System (QMS) governance throughout the product lifecycle—primarily focusing on design and pre‑market activities. Acting as a trusted partner to R&D and Regulatory Affairs, you will help drive informed decision‑making that safeguards patients while enabling compliant innovation.


Key Responsibilities


Design & Development Quality Leadership

  • Champion critical thinking across product development teams throughout all stages of design and development.
  • Serve as a subject‑matter expert in Design Controls, Risk Management, Electrical Safety, and Usability Engineering.
  • Ensure all design activities are properly executed, accurately documented, and compliant with internal procedures and global regulatory requirements.
  • Review Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and design changes to confirm sound engineering practice and maintained device safety and effectiveness.
  • Oversee efficient progression of design changes with complete, traceable, and compliant documentation.
  • Participate in cross‑functional design reviews, assessing design plans, inputs, outputs, V&V evidence, and change records.
  • Identify potential safety or performance concerns and support appropriate risk management activities.
  • Ensure design decisions are fully justified, documented, and aligned with regulatory expectations.


Risk Management

  • Contribute to risk management activities in accordance with ISO 14971.
  • Support hazard analyses, FMEAs, and related risk management documentation.
  • Ensure risk control measures are implemented, verified, and supported by objective evidence.
  • Provide structured, risk‑based decision‑making to support product safety and compliance.
  • Ensure risk–benefit evaluations are complete, clear, and aligned with global regulatory expectations.


Material Review Board (Design‑Related)

While the role does not oversee manufacturing or service activities, you will:

  • Participate in design‑related reviews of nonconforming materials and investigations where they impact design decisions, safety, or documentation.
  • Communicate trends or recurring issues to design teams.
  • Support corrective actions or design improvements based on nonconformance insights.


QMS Administration

  • Conduct internal quality audits to verify compliance with procedures and regulatory expectations.
  • Lead or support CAPA activities, ensuring effective verification and complete documentation.
  • Manage process change control for design‑related processes, ensuring proper evaluation, documentation, and approval.
  • Support external audits/inspections by representing design‑related quality processes.
  • Educate internal teams on quality obligations and alignment with the Spacelabs Quality Policy.
  • Maintain and improve QMS procedures, work instructions, and templates.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Quality, Engineering, or related fields (e.g., Computer/Software, Biomedical, Mechanical, Electrical).
  • 7+ years of relevant Quality or Engineering experience.
  • 5+ years working with medical device regulatory requirements, quality standards, and QMS.
  • Experience maintaining Technical Files, GSRPCs, Risk Management Files, Usability Files, Design History Files, MVPs, and Change Control documentation.
  • Experience with statistical analysis.
  • Knowledge of Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) or software within medical devices.
  • Experience collaborating with teams under design controls during new product development.
  • Strong communication skills across all levels of an organization.
  • Highly self‑motivated, organized, and proactive.

title: Software Engineer (remote, startup)
location: Santo Domingo, Distrito Nacional, Dominican Republic
description:
Our company

Meadow is rebuilding end-of-life care from scratch. In under two years, we've become the largest independent cremation provider in California, expanded to eight markets across four states, and served thousands of families with 5-star reviews and a 80+ NPS. We're backed by top investors and the team behind Moxie, the medspa platform now at national scale.

Deathcare is a $20B market that hasn't meaningfully changed in 70 years: opaque pricing, no digital presence, and families making the hardest decisions of their lives under pressure. We're building the modern alternative: transparent pricing, 24/7 hospitality, and software that handles the operational complexity so humans can focus on care.

Software Engineer

We're looking for a mid- to senior-level IC full-stack software engineer to keep our production systems healthy and move our internal tooling forward. You own features end-to-end, make architectural calls within a feature, and ship without a tech lead over your shoulder.

About 80% of your work will be on the tools our operations, sales, and care teams use every day to serve families; the rest touches the family-facing surfaces where those experiences land.

You'll also be stepping into a small, senior team comprised of our Head of Engineering and two other engineers. Your code reaches production quickly, and the problems you solve are felt directly by the people using the software the next day.

We work out of a single monorepo. FastAPI services in Python, Next.js/React apps in TypeScript, Inngest for event-driven workflows and pub/sub, and Postgres as our primary datastore.

Our objectives for the role

  • Ship full-stack features end-to-end across internal tooling and family-facing surfaces, Inngest workflows, FastAPI + Pydantic endpoints, and the React UIs that sit on top of them.
  • Triage production issues across our Python backends and TypeScript frontends, drive incidents to root cause, and leave the system better than you found it.
  • Keep improving the experience for our internal users (operations, sales, and service teams) who live in these tools every day and expand the tool set available to them as the business grows.

We're looking for

  • Mid-Senior IC: 3-7+ years shipping production software, with real day-job experience in both Python and TypeScript.
  • Fullstack: Comfort working across the stack. You don't need to be equally strong on frontend and backend, but you should be willing to own a feature from database to UI.
    • Experience with event-driven or job-queue systems (Inngest, Celery, SQS, Temporal, etc.) or a clear appetite to learn ours quickly.
  • Startup: You've worked at an early-stage startup before and know what that actually feels like: ambiguity, shifting priorities, and owning outcomes rather than tickets.
  • Timezone: Available during our core hours of 12 PM ET–8 PM ET, reachable for syncs and pairing.

Why join us?

We're a well-funded, 40-person team from Stripe, Google, Opendoor, Oscar, and a16z-backed companies, moving fast in a category that's been waiting for a real company to show up. We're opening new markets every month and hiring people who'd rather build than follow.

Deathcare today runs on paper, phone, and fax. Almost every other funeral company treats engineering as IT. At Meadow, software is how we scale and how we deliver a better experience for families, and it's one of our biggest competitive advantages. The tools you build are what the business runs on.

A small team that leans hard on LLMs ships like a much larger one. Engineers here use AI heavily in the dev loop, and LLMs power core product surfaces. If you've been stuck at a company where AI adoption is blocked by policy or legacy code, you'll feel the difference in week one.

To apply, or to ask questions before you do, reach out to Peter, our Head of Engineering.

Work setup

  • Long-term contractor via Deel
  • Based in Latin America (we’re remote first already). Core hours 12 PM–8 PM ET (noon–8 PM Colombia, 1 PM–9 PM Argentina, 11 AM–7 PM Mexico City).
  • The working language is English, including daily syncs.

  • On-call expectations: This role includes limited weekday on-call coverage. We ask that you be reachable by phone for the 3 hours after your shift, up to 11pm Eastern, for urgent production issues that require engineering support. Weekend coverage is currently handled separately.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About us

At Zego, we think traditional motor insurance holds good drivers back. It's too complicated, too expensive, and it doesn't take into account how well you actually drive.

Since 2016, we've been changing that — building insurance priced fairly for good drivers, from van drivers and gig workers to everyday motorists. We've sold tens of millions of policies and raised over $200M in funding. And we're only just getting started.

About the role

We're hiring a Backend Engineer to join one of our product teams. This is a hands-on backend role for someone early in their career who's already shipping code professionally and wants to grow into a Backend Engineer — fast.

You'll be supported by experienced engineers and a strong team culture, but we'll expect you to own your work, ask good questions, and actively drive your own development. This isn't a role for someone who wants to sit at this level for years. We want someone with their eye on what's next.

What you will be doing

  • Building, testing, and shipping backend services that power products used by our customers every day
  • Writing clear, well-tested code that you and your teammates will be happy to maintain
  • Reviewing other engineers' code and learning from theirs
  • Pairing with senior engineers on harder problems and levelling up along the way
  • Asking questions, seeking feedback, and taking ownership of the things you don't yet know
  • Using AI tools as part of your daily workflow — and helping the team get better at using them

About you

We don't mind which language you've been writing in. What matters is that you've been actively developing software in a professional setting and have solid programming fundamentals — data structures, basic algorithms, OOP, testing, version control. Our stack is mostly Python, and you'll pick it up quickly if you don't already know it.

What we really care about{{:}}

  • Growth mindset{{:}} You treat gaps in your knowledge as opportunities, not weaknesses. You go and find what you don't know rather than waiting to be told
  • Curiosity about AI{{:}} You're already experimenting with AI tools in your work, or you're hungry to. You see them as leverage
  • Hunger to progress{{:}} You want to be a Senior Engineer, and you want to get there as fast as you reasonably can. You're up for putting in the work
  • Initiative{{:}} You don't wait around for the next task or the next learning opportunity. You go looking
  • Good communication{{:}} You can explain what you're working on, ask for help when you're stuck, and give useful feedback in code reviews.

What's it like to work at Zego?

Joining Zego is a career-defining move. People go further here, reaching their full potential to achieve extraordinary things. 

We're spread between Portugal and the UK, and united by our drive to get things done. We're proud of our company and our culture - a friendly and inclusive space where we can lift each other up and celebrate our wins every day.

Together, we're setting the bar higher, delivering exceptional work that makes a difference. Our people are the most important part of our story, and everyone here plays a role. There's loads of room to learn and grow, and you'll get the freedom to steer your career wherever you want.

You'll work alongside a talented group who embrace each other's differences and aren't afraid of a challenge. We recognise our achievements, learn from our mistakes, and help each other to be the best we can be. Together, we're making insurance matter. 

How we work

We believe that teams work better when they have time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid. While some of our team choose to come into our central London office once a week, we're flexible - some people prefer being in once a month or even quarterly. It's all about finding the right balance between collaborative face time and focused home-working, so we can achieve great results while maintaining a healthy work-life balance

Our approach to AI

AI is changing how we work, and we want people who are leaning into that — using it to move faster, think differently, and focus on what matters. You don't need to be an expert. You do need to be curious and intentional about how you use it.

Benefits

We reward our people well. Join us and you'll get a market-competitive salary, private medical insurance, company share options, generous holiday allowance, and a whole lot of wellbeing benefits. We also offer an annual flexible hybrid working contribution, which you can use to support with your travel to the office or towards your own personal development. And that's just for starters! 

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Design Engineer
description:
Who we are
Enterprise teams still copy data between systems all day. Work gets stuck in emails, legacy UIs, and handoffs. That chaos is costly, slow, and risky.
We're a fast-moving team on a mission to end it for good. Traction is strong and we're solving real problems for real customers—but to win, we need exceptional talent. We stay humble, do the work, and let results speak.
What we are building
We're building the AI operations platform for retail and CPG enterprises—a horizontal platform where AI agents execute end-to-end work across UIs and APIs with governance built in.
Where copilots stop, Duvo finishes the job. Business users specify the outcome; agents plan, act, request approvals on exceptions, and learn with every run. We start with a retail wedge (category management, supply chain, finance ops) where ROI is obvious, then expand to adjacent functions and sectors.
Velocity is our moat: ship fast, iterate faster, compound learning.
The role
You will own the
intersection of design and engineering
— you don't hand off mockups, you ship the final experience. You combine strong visual and interaction design skills with production-quality frontend engineering to build interfaces that are beautiful, functional, and fast.
You'll design and build surfaces like: AI agent builder flows, operational dashboards with real-time case management, process analysis viewers, and integration setup wizards.
Your unit of ownership:
the quality of user-facing experiences, from design concept through production implementation. You own how it looks, how it feels, and how it's built.
We're a growing product team scaling into multiple initiatives, each with a lead, engineers, a design engineer, and an AI-focused engineer.
What we're looking for
These are non-negotiables—the things we'll specifically evaluate you on:
Design craft in data-heavy, enterprise interfaces. You can make complex information feel simple. You have a sharp eye for typography, spacing, color, hierarchy, and interaction design — and you apply it to real product surfaces, not just portfolios.
Frontend engineering. You write production-quality React code. You understand component architecture, performance, accessibility, and how to build UIs that hold up under real usage.
Shipping end-to-end. You own features from concept to production. You don't just design — you build, test, and ship. You don't just code — you think about the user experience holistically.
Product judgment. You make good design and scope decisions that balance user needs, technical constraints, and business goals. You can define what "good enough" looks like for a first iteration and what "great" looks like for the next.
Collaboration. You work effectively with engineers, product, and other designers. You give and receive critique well, and you use feedback to make the work better, not to defend it.
AI interaction design. You'll design AI interaction patterns where no established UX conventions exist — and iterate based on what you learn from real enterprise users.
You might also
Have experience designing complex, data-heavy enterprise interfaces.
Have a deep understanding of motion design and microinteractions that make interfaces feel alive.
Be passionate about design systems — building and maintaining component libraries that scale.
This is not for you if
You want to set org-level design direction and build a team — see Head of Design.
You'd rather define the system than build features within it.
Our tech stack
TypeScript-first
React and Fastify
Tailwind CSS
Postgres, GCP
Latest AI primitives
How we work
These Are Real Tradeoffs We've Made, Not Aspirations
Initiative-driven. We organize around customer problems, not org charts. Problems surface through product feedback, competitive analysis, and direct customer conversations — then we prioritize, build, and ship weekly.
Customer-obsessed. We solve real problems, not hypothetical ones. Features that don't move customer metrics get cut.
Iterative by default. We ship small, learn fast, and never get attached to yesterday's code. This means things break sometimes — we fix forward.
AI-first leverage. We use AI to move faster and focus human time where it matters most. If a tool can do it, a person shouldn't.
Direct feedback. We give each other actionable feedback immediately. This can feel uncomfortable — we think that's worth it.
Autonomy with accountability. We trust people to make decisions and hold them to outcomes, not process.
What we offer
Unlimited AI budget. We don't just allow AI tools — we strongly encourage them. Want to try a new tool? Buy it. Want to automate part of your workflow? Do it.
Autonomy to do your best work. Want to meet someone to learn from? Set it up. Want a mentor? Go get one. Want to fly out to talk to an important customer? Just ask.
A real AI product with real customers. You're not building demos or internal tools. Enterprise customers use what you ship, and their feedback drives what you build next.
A sharp, motivated team that values ownership and candor.
Competitive compensation with a meaningful equity component. You can trade salary for additional equity if you prefer more upside.
How we hire
We Respect Your Time And Aim To Move Fast
Hiring manager screen (30 min). We'll look at your portfolio, talk about what you've designed and built, and whether there's mutual fit.
Remote task (async, time-boxed, ~1 hour). A realistic design + code exercise — design and implement a small interface. We care about both the design decisions and the code quality.
Technical interview (Prague, ~1 hour). Meet the team. We'll go deeper on design critique, frontend architecture, and collaboration. No trick questions — we want to see how you think and build.
On-site trial day (2 days). Design and ship something small to production with us and see how we work together. Fully compensated.

title: Senior Quality Engineer

About Us

Xsensio is an innovation-driven digital health company dedicated to solving one of the biggest challenges in healthcare: the lack of real-time, continuous monitoring of relevanxt health parameters. Our mission is realized through our breakthrough Lab-on-Skin™ wearable platform—a modular, miniaturized sensing solution offering unique health insights through the continuous and real-time analysis of proteins and hormones at the surface of the skin. We aim to revolutionize healthcare with simple, minimally invasive solutions to improve the standard of care during critical health events.


Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and rigorous Senior Quality Engineer to join our growing team at a pivotal stage of device development. You will own our quality management system and drive quality documentation across design controls, preclinical activities, and clinical investigation — working closely with engineers and scientists throughout the process. This critical role spans the full development lifecycle, from DHF documentation and risk management through to Swissmedic submission support. As part of Xsensio, you will work in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment where your contributions will directly shape the path forwardregulatory and quality foundation of a novel wearable biosensing device.


Responsibilities

  • eQMS: own and maintain the quality management system day-to-day, ensuring it remains accurate, used, and coherent as the project evolves.

  • Suppliers: qualify and maintain supplier records and purchasing documentation.

Experience

  • Background: 5+ years in MedTech quality roles, with direct experience on Class IIa or IIb devices.

  • Standards: strong ISO 13485 foundations; working knowledge of ISO 14971 and ISO 14155; solid understanding of MDR requirements including Technical File structure and notified body expectations - not just basic awareness.

title: End-to-End Platform QA Specialist
description:
End-to-End Platform QA Specialist

Part-Time or Full-Time — Europe Remote


About Eduneon

We build software that helps German municipalities and school authorities run procurement, asset management, and project delivery.

Real public administrators rely on us. When our software fails, real services slow down — so reliability and data privacy aren’t features, they’re foundations.


🧩 About the Role

We’re hiring a QA Specialist to take ownership of end-to-end platform quality.

This is not a click-through-the-tickets role. You will become one of the people who knows Eduneon better than anyone else — finding the bugs automated tests will never catch, and then helping build the automated tests that catch them next time.


Find it manually, then automate it so we never see it again.

We’re open to both part-time and full-time arrangements. We care more about the quality of testing than the hours logged.


🔍 What You’ll Do
  • Test the full platform end-to-end — run real workflows that span inventory → needs → procurement → budgeting → projects → tickets, and break the seams where modules hand off.
  • Run structured exploratory sessions — time-boxed charters, not random clicking; apply tours, boundary analysis, and risk-based coverage.
  • Break things on purpose — edge cases, weird inputs, role switches mid-task, race conditions, and multi-tenant boundaries.
  • Probe permissions and roles — verify that admins, school staff, and municipal users see exactly what they should, nothing more.
  • Write bug reports developers love — minimal repro steps, expected vs. actual, environment, evidence, and severity vs. priority.
  • Automate what you find — convert reproducible bugs into automated regression tests with Playwright so the same issue never ships twice.
  • Think like our users — would this hold up on a busy Tuesday morning in a real Schulamt office?


✅ Requirements
  • 2+ years of professional QA experience on complex, multi-module web apps, such as B2B SaaS, ERP, public sector, or similar.
  • Demonstrable experience with structured exploratory testing, not just scripted execution.
  • Excellent written English — bug reports and session notes are your primary deliverables.
  • Comfort with bug tracking and test management tools, such as Jira, Linear, TestRail, Xray, or similar.
  • Strong working knowledge of browser DevTools and an API client, such as Postman, Insomnia, or similar.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one E2E automation framework, such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar — you can write, run, and maintain automated tests, not just read them.
  • Ability to reason about user roles, permissions, and multi-tenant data boundaries.
  • Self-directed — you can plan a week of testing and report progress without daily handholding.


⭐ Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience testing GDPR-sensitive, regulated, or public-sector software.
  • Working SQL knowledge — peeking into PostgreSQL to verify backend state.
  • German language ability, helpful but not required.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar.
  • A track record of finding the bug nobody else found.


🧠 The Mindset We’re Looking For
  • Curiosity over compliance — you want to understand the system, then challenge it.
  • Adversarial empathy — you can think like a happy user and a malicious one in the same session.
  • Pattern recognition — when something feels off in module A, you check module C for the same root cause.
  • Discipline in writing — you take pride in repro steps that work the first time.
  • Skepticism toward your own assumptions — when something works as expected, you ask whether you actually verified it.
  • Patience with intermittent bugs — you’ll spend two hours isolating a flaky issue and not get bored.


🤖 How We Approach AI in QA

We use AI as a thinking partner, not as a replacement for judgment.

  • AI can help generate ideas, test cases, or edge-case prompts — but judgment about what is risky stays with you.
  • Never paste customer data, real personal data, or production exports into public AI tools. GDPR and data residency are foundational.
  • AI-generated test cases often cover the obvious and miss the weird — the weird is your job.
  • Permissions, access control, and multi-tenant boundaries deserve human-first scrutiny.

We measure QA success by bugs caught before users see them — not by tickets closed.


🌍 Why Join Eduneon?

At Eduneon, your QA work directly improves software used by municipalities and school authorities to manage real public infrastructure workflows.

This is not generic SaaS testing. It is quality work with operational impact.

You will help us make Eduneon more reliable, more intuitive, more secure, and more trustworthy for the people who rely on it every day.


📍 Your Set-Up
  • Europe Remote
  • Berlin-based company
  • Part-time or full-time possible

🚀 Ready to Join?

If you love getting deeply absorbed in complex systems, finding edge cases nobody else sees, and turning manual findings into long-term automated protection — we would love to hear from you.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We’re looking for a Senior Software Developer in Test to play a key role in shaping the future of our testing ecosystem. In this role, you’ll own and evolve our AWS/Kubernetes‑based test infrastructure, build and optimize automation frameworks, support functional and performance testing across our platforms. You’ll develop internal QA tools, improve testing practices, and collaborate closely with engineering teams to drive high‑quality delivery at scale. You will also contribute to our long‑term QA strategy, including the adoption of AI‑powered testing capabilities.


WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Own and maintain the test infrastructure and tooling ecosystem, including AWS‑based resources, Kubernetes environments, and CI/CD test executors.

  • Lead and support functional and performance automation initiatives in collaboration with QA and development teams.

  • Drive the development and enhancement of internal QA tooling, including the QES portal, simulators, and custom test utilities.
  • Participate in shaping QA strategy by integrating AI tools and capabilities into QA processes, infrastructure, and internal testing platforms.

  • Salary starts from 3200€/m gross based on previous experience.
  • This role is meant for employment only. B2B (SZČO/s.r.o.) is not possible.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO HAVE:

  • 5+ years in QA/SDET roles with hands‑on ownership of test infrastructure and automation in cloud environments.
  • Proven experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker for building and operating scalable test platforms.
  • Strong track record designing and maintaining test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines using Gitlab.
  • Strong experience with test automation tools such as Playwright and Selenium, and tools for performance testing , like K6 / JMeter.
  • Proficiency in Java plus at least one of JavaScript/TypeScript/Python for test tooling and frameworks.

  • Demonstrated ability to debug complex pipeline/infrastructure issues and enforce security, compliance, and patching standards.


WHAT WOULD BE GREAT TO HAVE:

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
location: City Of London, England, United Kingdom
description:
About Us


We are not your run-of-the-mill bank. It's our people which makes us exceptional. Every individual here is valued - not just for what they do, but for who they are. We’ve built a culture rooted in purpose, passion, and a healthy dose of humanity.


Joining Alpha Bank London isn’t just about a career - it’s about connection. You’ll collaborate with colleagues from all walks of life, building bonds that last and networks that matter. It’s this blend of international reach and local expertise that makes us strong. Whether you’re starting out or stepping up. You’ll find responsibility, variety, and experiences that go far beyond what a boutique bank or a corporate giant could offer alone. Together, we amplify ideas, share knowledge, and create impact.


We believe in doing well and doing good. That means more than closing deals; it’s about making a difference for our clients, our communities, and each other. Because when one of us succeeds, we all succeed.


Ready to make your mark? Let’s do it. Together.


The Role


We are seeking a detail-oriented professional to support Alpha Bank London’s bank-wide First Line Quality Assurance (QA) programme within the Operations Controls and Governance function.


You will contribute to the execution of quality assurance reviews across multiple business areas and risk types, helping to provide robust oversight and drive continuous improvement. This is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to the Bank’s operations while playing a critical role in maintaining a strong control environment.


This is a perfect opportunity for someone looking to move into their second job.


What You’ll Do


  • Lead the end-to-end execution of Quality Assurance (QA) activities within the First Line of Defence, delivering independent, risk-based assurance that key processes, controls and customer outcomes operate effectively and meet regulatory expectations.
  • Provide QA coverage across Products, Sales and Operations, supporting core business areas including Real Estate Finance, Private Banking, Deposits, Current Accounts, Payments and Investment Services, while also supporting new and evolving offerings such as mortgages and debit cards.
  • Support oversight of complaints and vulnerable customers through thematic and root cause analysis, identification of cross-functional issues, action tracking, and management information (MI) reporting.
  • Deliver the annual QA programme, managing activities across the full QA lifecycle from planning through to reporting and follow-up.
  • Conduct risk-based testing, including sample reviews, thematic deep dives and control assessments, to identify control weaknesses and process gaps.
  • Review and document evidence to an audit-ready standard, ensuring robust and defensible testing conclusions.
  • Draft clear, concise findings and practical recommendations, outlining key risks, regulatory or policy impacts, root causes and potential consequences.
  • Produce high-quality QA reports and summaries highlighting key risks, themes and trends.
  • Track and monitor remediation actions, providing ongoing oversight and follow-up assurance to confirm effective resolution.


What We’re Looking For


Experience:

  • Background in Quality Assurance, compliance monitoring, or controls assurance within financial services
  • Knowledge of operational risk management within a banking environment
  • Exposure to First or Second Line activities such as issue management, incident management, or control testing
  • Strong preference for candidates with direct banking experience
  • Desirable experience across retail or private banking, real estate finance, deposits, payments, or investment services


Key Attributes:

  • Understanding of risk and control frameworks, with the ability to evaluate how controls operate in practice
  • Ability to execute structured testing independently and to a high professional standard
  • Excellent attention to detail, with the confidence to assess, challenge and validate evidence
  • Clear and confident communication skills, both written and verbal, including presenting findings to senior stakeholders


Qualifications (Preferred):

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Risk or a related field
  • Professional qualification, or working towards one (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CIA or equivalent)


Why Join Us?


At Alpha Bank London, our values shape everything we do:

  • Collaboration – Work closely with a supportive team to achieve shared goals.
  • Excellence – Deliver accurate, high-quality work that makes a difference.
  • Delivery – See the results of your efforts in real-time operations.
  • Empowerment – Take ownership of your tasks and build skills for your next career step.

title: Senior Python Developer (all genders)
description:
Your role

We’re seeking a seasoned Senior Python Developer who enjoys solving real-world operational puzzles to join our team. At Sunday Natural, our digital products are the invisible engine behind our premium nutrients, from raw material sourcing to final production. In this role, you won’t just be writing code; you will be the technical architect ensuring our software systems perfectly mirror our physical supply chain. You’ll act as a vital bridge between our engineering core and our Manufacturing and Supply Planning departments, building the robust tools that keep our global operations running with scientific precision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Backend Architecture: Design and implement scalable Python services that form the backbone of our production and logistics infrastructure.
  • Operational Partnership: Collaborate closely with Supply Planning and Manufacturing stakeholders to translate complex physical workflows into intuitive, automated software solutions.
  • Process Automation: Develop and optimize backend logic for inventory management, production scheduling, and demand forecasting to eliminate manual friction.
  • System Evolution: Support the continuous improvement and integration of our Odoo ERP environment, ensuring data flows seamlessly across the entire business.
  • Mentorship & Quality: Lead by example with high-quality, testable code and provide technical guidance to the wider team to foster a culture of engineering excellence.

Your profile

  • 6+ years of professional experience in backend development with a mastery of Python and its modern frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • Stakeholder Bridge-Builder: Proven track record of working directly with operational teams like Manufacturing, Supply Planning, or Logistics to solve business-critical bottlenecks.
  • Domain Awareness: You understand the logic behind supply chain processes—such as lead times, Bill of Materials (BOM), and inventory cycles—and know how to model them in code.
  • Data Mastery: Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL or other relational databases, with the ability to optimize performance for complex, high-volume transactions.
  • Architectural Mindset: You prioritize stability, maintainability, and clean code, with a strong commitment to TDD and Git-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Bonus Points: Experience with Odoo (OpenERP) is a strong plus

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients
  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year
  • The Urban Sports Club membership, Swapfiets bike rental and a subsidy for the Deutschland Ticket
  • We believe great things happen when we work flexibly, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with up to four home office days –up to five depending on the business need– and up to two weeks per year working from abroad.
  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia
  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas
  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world
  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply for this job

About Us

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 350 employees from more than 40 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

You will work on complex crawling and ingestion pipelines that collect and structure data from diverse sources such as web pages, APIs, PDFs, and documents. The environment is fast-moving, collaborative, and engineering-driven, with a strong emphasis on ownership, scalability, and problem-solving. You will contribute to the design of robust data architectures that support downstream analytics, classification, and machine learning use cases. The role combines Python engineering, distributed systems, and search technologies in a highly production-oriented setting. This is an ideal position for someone who enjoys tackling challenging data problems at scale and building systems that evolve continuously.

description:
As the IT organization of REWE International, we work with more than 700 colleagues to build innovative IT products and services for our business units in Austria and across international markets—setting the pace for modern retail.

We are looking for a Java Backend / Python Developer who enjoys building robust, scalable backend systems and working with complex, data‑driven platforms. In this role, you will design and implement high‑quality services and APIs, and work with a broad range of business and customer‑related data across different domains.

Using Java and Python, you will develop backend services, process and enrich larger datasets, and contribute to a platform that supports CRM, customer analytics, and operational use cases, as well as spatial and location‑related scenarios where relevant. A key focus is to design solutions that are scalable, reusable, and well prepared for future analytics and AI use cases.

You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across IT and business and support requirements engineering where needed. You will report directly to the CPO and work in a high‑ownership setup without a dedicated team, where initiative, technical excellence, and hands‑on problem solving make a real difference.



Job Description

  • You support the full software development lifecycle — from designing and modeling required components to implementing and customizing software solutions.
  • You build high-performing, scalable backend services using Java (Spring Boot) and/or Python, ensuring technical robustness and long-term maintainability.
  • Through thoughtful design and continuous optimization, you ensure our IT solutions are future-proof and ready for long-term, international use
  • Together with your colleagues, you align code architecture and API/interface contracts across teams and products, and document solutions in a clear and traceable way.
  • You critically evaluate technical decisions and provide constructive feedback on their impact on structure, performance, reliability, and business/system lo
  • You actively contribute to evolving our engineering and quality standards — from clean code practices and automated testing to CI/CD and delivery pipelines.
  • Working closely with your team, you help drive the technical modernization of our product and platform.

Qualifications

  • You have a solid technical education (HTL, University of Applied Sciences, or University degree) and minimum 3 years of professional experience in backend development.
  • Strong proficiency in modern Java (Spring Boot) and building robust, maintainable microservices
  • You work confidently with RESTful APIs (design, implementation, versioning) and understand how to build stable interface contracts in distributed systems
  • You have strong experience with relational databases and enjoy working in a data-driven way; you know how to model data, write efficient SQL, and optimize queries
  • Foundational understanding of event-driven architectures and platform tools (e.g., Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab, Liquibase), with a strong motivation to deepen your expertise.
  • You bring practical Python skills for data processing and automation, such as building data pipelines, transforming datasets, and developing ETL or backend support scripts.

  • You enjoy working in agile teams (Scrum or Kanban) and maintain an open, constructive approach to learning from mistakes.
  • Analytical and self-driven, with a strong ability to collaborate and deliver production-ready solutions
  • English: Minimum Level B2 (confident spoken and written communication in everyday work situations)

Additional Information

  • Long-term, interesting and varied work for a reliable employer in a supportive team
  • A family-friendly company culture with flexible working hours and remote working options available according to your individual needs
  • Numerous training and further development opportunities within the Group (5% of working time for self-organized training and education)
  • Staff shopping and travel discounts
  • Easy public access and on-site parking
  • An attractive annual gross salary, market-compliant and performance-related, starting at EUR 50.000 with the possibility of higher pay based on your qualifications and professional experience.

Apply now!

title: Full Stack Engineer

Who we are?
Cowlabs is a multi-product studio. Our team creates successful products from scratch combining technical expertise, business experience, and a rich network of innovators. We build consumer-oriented software products that users love. One of our portfolio ventures — a digital health platform helping people take control of their personal health records and medical history — is hiring its next Full Stack Developer. Built in Switzerland, hosted in Switzerland, owned by the user.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who loves coding and can do "anything", because you are equally excited about making stuff as you are good at it. From crunching bits to optimising database queries, adding that extra juicy transition in UIs, spinning up a scalable infrastructure to optimising data storage and retrieval. It is all just coding, right?
As a Full Stack Developer you:
Love working across layers, languages, and platforms.
Are capable of building production-ready applications.
Prioritise user experience and balance rapid development with future scalability.
Care about how data is handled — you understand that "owned by the user" is a technical commitment, not just a marketing line.
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a force multiplier, not a crutch.
We prioritise hardcore skills, curiosity, and a natural ability to get things done, rather than formal education or years of experience. If you have ever built your own startup, regardless of the outcome, that's a huge plus!
What will you do?
As an early team member, you'll have a significant influence on the tech stack and overall approach. The current stack is TypeScript top to bottom with Node, NextJS and React on Vercel for web, combined with Expo/React Native for mobile. Building and deploying end-to-end features on mobile and web platforms.
Shaping day-to-day operations and the development team's workflow.
Helping decide what to build, not just how to build it.

This full-time position offers adequate startup compensation in your preferred currency and share options. Remote and Switzerland-based, with regular in-person time with the team.

This venture is on a path toward spinning out from the studio as an independent company. title: AI Engineer – Python, GenAI & Machine Learning (m/f)
description:
Join PwC Slovakia as an AI Engineer, where you will lead and contribute to AI and data science solutions for leading global clients. This role is open for candidates based in Slovakia and is part of the long‑term growth of PwC Slovakia.

Our AI team is expanding rapidly — in the last 6 months alone, we’ve welcomed more than 20 new colleagues, and we’re continuing to grow. This role is not a replacement; we are scaling the team because we have a strong pipeline of AI projects. We are currently hiring across multiple seniority levels — from junior to senior engineers — as the demand for our AI solutions keeps increasing.

This role is designed for experienced developers and engineers who want to architect, build, and deploy machine learning systems and data-driven applications at scale. We are looking for candidates who are strong in Python, confident working with data, and capable of turning complex business challenges into reliable, production-ready AI solutions — while engaging directly with clients across Western Europe and the USA.

On top of the broader AI profiles, we’re also looking specifically for Microsoft + Azure AI experts—hands-on engineers with Python and ideally Azure AI Foundry experience—who want to build production-grade AI solutions with global impact.

Key Responsibilities:

  • AI Solution Development: Innovate and develop cutting-edge AI and ML solutions with a strong focus on Python-based implementation, spanning areas such as generative AI, classical machine learning, computer vision, and data analysis.
  • Project Involvement: Engage actively in AI and data science projects from conception to deployment, contributing to solution design and codebase while ensuring timely delivery.
  • Client Collaboration: Work directly with clients across Western Europe and the USA, understanding their needs and providing expert guidance and tailored solutions.
  • Learning & Development: Stay at the forefront of AI and data science trends, learning new approaches, and contributing to improvements of existing solutions and processes.
  • Mentorship: Support the growth of junior team members by sharing knowledge and guiding them in project involvement and technical skills.

Who We're Looking For:

  • Programming Skills (Key Requirement): Solid programming skills in Python (e.g. pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, plotly). Ability to write and understand code is essential. Experience with other programming languages is a plus.
  • AI/ML Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience in projects involving Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, or ML model development and deployment. The focus is on building and implementing solutions, not only using AI tools. Strong foundations in statistics and ML fundamentals are valued.
  • Professional Background: At least 2 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Database Expertise: Proficient in SQL databases; familiarity with NoSQL databases is an advantage.
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to approach problems logically and creatively.
  • Independence & Leadership: Demonstrated ability to deliver impactful results independently while guiding project components and mentoring others.
  • Language Skills: English at B2 level or higher.

Projects you could be involved in:

  • Natural Language Data Exploration: Develop dashboards powered by GenAI for intuitive business data analysis.
  • Document Interaction: Design tools enabling seamless interaction with unstructured and structured text documents.
  • Knowledge Assistant: Implement ERP transformation with GenAI tools to resolve employee inquiries efficiently.
  • Agricultural Monitoring: Utilize Computer Vision for analyzing satellite imagery on a large scale.
  • Automated Reconciliation: Create systems to identify anomalous transactions in accounting ledgers.

  • Conference presentation: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v3epaKs2piA

  • Thought leadership: https://www.pwc.com/gx/en/issues/technology/path-to-generative-ai-value.html

Benefits you can enjoy while working at PwC:

  • Financial Rewards: Benefit from regular salary reviews, performance bonuses and other special bonuses. Enjoy meal contributions and a cafeteria benefit system offering personalized choices.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Enjoy our hybrid working policy, flexible working hours, 2 extra days off during Christmas along with Sick-days. Every minute of your extra work is valued and compensated.
  • Career Development: Engage in tailored internal and external training programs as well as structured career development plan.
  • Health & Well-being: Access premium benefits such as Multisport card or a medical center membership. Take advantage of our Well-being and Work-Life Coaching program.
  • Supportive Culture: Participate in team building activities and social events and join our employee referral program. Experience a culture with regular feedback and a supportive environment.
  • Global Opportunities: Seize the opportunity for international assignments and work on diverse projects with international clients. Explore the world while working with the possibility of working from abroad.
  • Extra perks: Use various discounts at partner companies such as cars, health care, beauty, culture or others. Transfer up to 4 telephone numbers at discounted rates.

(For candidates with many years of experience, the salary is negotiable based on experience and proven seniority.)
